title: Hornbill Festival 2026: Dates, Entry Permit, How to Reach Kisama and Where to Stay
seoTitle: Hornbill Festival 2026: Dates, ILP, Travel and Stay
seoDescription: Hornbill Festival 2026 runs 1–10 December at Kisama near Kohima. Nagaland ILP fee and validity, foreigner PAP rules, Dimapur–Kohima travel and stays.
excerpt: The permits you need (Indian ILP at ₹200 for 30 days, PAP for foreigners), realistic Dimapur–Kisama travel times and fares, and a simple 3-day plan that avoids the worst crowds.
